pb=abs(p-b); pc=abs(p-c)\n            if pa<=pb and pa<=pc: pr=a\n            elif pb<=pc: pr=b\n            else: pr=c\n            line[i]=(line[i]+pr)&0xFF\n    rows.append(line)\n    prev = line\n\nwith open('/tmp/img.pkl','wb') as f:\n    pickle.dump((width,height,rows), f)\nprint(\"done\")\nEOF\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":1051,"cache_read_input_tokens":39774,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":1051,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":2,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"09089ba5-95b2-42b8-87d2-2bab4cec3238","uuid":"a17f1175-1a4c-487c-a0de-8f9cfb5cec62","timestamp":"2026-08-02T07:17:17.878Z"}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5","id":"msg_011CddWhx1WFUpZJMtL7LhYy","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01H1fziq58mvJzjF7S6tqogA","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"cd /tmp && python3 << 'EOF'\nimport pickle, math\nwidth,height,rows = pickle.load(open('/tmp/img.pkl','rb'))\n\ndef px(x,y):\n    o = x*4\n    return rows[y][o],rows[y][o+1],rows[y][o+2],rows[y][o+3]\n\ndef is_gray(x,y):\n    r,g,b,a = px(x,y)\n    return a>0 and not (r>240 and g>240 and b>240)\n\n# scan region for top chart: x 750-1270, y 30-450\nminx=miny=10**9\nmaxx=maxy=-1\nfor y in range(30,450):\n    for x in range(750,1270):\n        if is_gray(x,y):\n            if x<minx: minx=x\n            if x>maxx: maxx=x\n            if y<miny: miny=y\n            if y>maxy: maxy=y\nprint(\"top bbox\", minx,maxx,miny,maxy)\ncx = (minx+maxx)/2\ncy = (miny+maxy)/2\nr = (maxx-minx)/2\nprint(\"center,radius\", cx,cy,r)\n\n# Now sample circle at radius 0.95*r for angles 0..360, find where white line crosses (border between fill and background at edge is white but that's outer boundary; internal separator lines go all the way to edge though thin)\n# instead sample at radius 0.5*r (mid) and detect non-gray (white) pixels = separator lines\nradius = r*0.6\nangles_white = []\nfor deg10 in range(3600):\n    theta = deg10/10.0\n    rad = math.radians(theta)\n    x = cx + radius*math.cos(rad)\n    y = cy + radius*math.sin(rad)\n    xi, yi = int(round(x)), int(round(y))\n    if 0<=xi<width and 0<=yi<height:\n        r_,g_,b_,a_ = px(xi,yi)\n        if a_>0 and r_>200 and g_>200 and b_>200:\n            angles_white.append(theta)\n\n# group consecutive angles into clusters\nclusters=[]\ncur=[angles_white[0]] if angles_white else []\nfor a in angles_white[1:]:\n    if a - cur[-1] <= 1.0:\n        cur.append(a)\n    else:\n        clusters.append(cur)\n        cur=[a]\nif cur:\n    clusters.append(cur)\n# handle wraparound\nif clusters and clusters[0][0] < 1 and clusters[-1][-1] > 359:\n    clusters[0] = clusters[-1] + clusters[0]\n    clusters.pop()\n\nprint(\"num clusters\", len(clusters))\nfor c in clusters:\n    print(sum(c)/len(c), min(c), max(c))\nEOF\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":393,"cache_read_input_tokens":41763,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":393,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":2,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"09089ba5-95b2-42b8-87d2-2bab4cec3238","uuid":"5f8ea885-3402-40f3-b149-9ae2a86dd277","timestamp":"2026-08-02T07:17:37.700Z"}

{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5","id":"msg_011CddWtk1FJWHJY4rYu7u4u","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01V8JDprDD4CGLM239wMyTYY","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"cd /tmp && python3 << 'EOF'\nimport pickle, math\nwidth,height,rows = pickle.load(open('/tmp/img.pkl','rb'))\n\ndef px(x,y):\n    o = x*4\n    return rows[y][o],rows[y][o+1],rows[y][o+2],rows[y][o+3]\n\ndef is_gray(x,y):\n    r,g,b,a = px(x,y)\n    return a>0 and not (r>240 and g>240 and b>240)\n\nminx=miny=10**9\nmaxx=maxy=-1\nfor y in range(470,868):\n    for x in range(700,1270):\n        if is_gray(x,y):\n            if x<minx: minx=x\n            if x>maxx: maxx=x\n            if y<miny: miny=y\n            if y>maxy: maxy=y\nprint(\"bottom bbox\", minx,maxx,miny,maxy, \"w\",maxx-minx,\"h\",maxy-miny)\ncx=(minx+maxx)/2\ncy=(miny+maxy)/2\nr=(maxx-minx)/2\nprint(cx,cy,r)\n\nfor frac in [0.5,0.7,0.9]:\n    radius=r*frac\n    whites=[]\n    for deg100 in range(36000):\n        theta=deg100/100.0\n        rad=math.radians(theta)\n        x=cx+radius*math.cos(rad)\n        y=cy+radius*math.sin(rad)\n        xi,yi=int(round(x)),int(round(y))\n        if 0<=xi<width and 0<=yi<height:\n            rr,gg,bb,aa=px(xi,yi)\n            if aa>0 and rr>200 and gg>200 and bb>200:\n                whites.append(theta)\n    clusters=[]\n    if whites:\n        cur=[whites[0]]\n        for a in whites[1:]:\n            if a-cur[-1]<=0.5:\n                cur.append(a)\n            else:\n                clusters.append(cur); cur=[a]\n        clusters.append(cur)\n        if len(clusters)>1 and clusters[0][0]<1 and clusters[-1][-1]>359:\n            clusters[0]=clusters[-1]+clusters[0]\n            clusters.pop()\n    print(\"frac\",frac,\"clusters\",len(clusters))\n    for c in clusters:\n        print(\"  mean\",sum(c)/len(c),\"count\",len(c))\nEOF\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":671,"cache_read_input_tokens":48215,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":671,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0},"output_tokens":4,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global"},"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"09089ba5-95b2-42b8-87d2-2bab4cec3238","uuid":"05ed4656-f468-4d1c-83ca-5e3c27a5dc33","timestamp":"2026-08-02T07:20:36.736Z"}
